claims_checked.claim: Many konbini provide microwaves, utensils, and customer bins; some have eat-in counters or few seats.
Eat-in policies changed during COVID; not all stores restored seating.
Standing eat-in is the same as tabearuki.
Eating standing is a traditional Japanese dining custom.

caveats_about_absolutes: Note regional, generational, and situational variation
Hedge statistics; do not invent cashless percentages
